newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Serbian minister shot dead in restaurant.
newsitem.headline: Serbian minister shot dead in restaurant.

text.p: A masked gunman shot dead Serbian deputy Interior Minister Radovan Stojicic Bazda as was eating in a crowded Belgrade restaurant very early on Friday.
Media reports said Badza, a police general, was attacked shortly after midnight while dining with his son and a friend in the Mama Mia restaurant in central Belgrade and died immediately.
His attacker fled and there were no other casualties. The interior ministry said it would issue a statement later.
Badza headed the ministry's public security department.
Public shootings are a regular occurrence in Belgrade but the victims are usually members of the vast mafia which flourished in Serbia under U.N. sanctions after former Yugoslavia broke up.
